demonstration: Owner-commissioned live test through the public MCP API, not customer traction

request.objective: Use the approved CSV group-sum tool to aggregate all 120 synthetic invoice rows in invoices by supplier, summing amount_usd. Create supplier_totals.csv with one row for each of the six suppliers and the columns supplier,total_usd. Create brief.md stating that 120 generated invoices were grouped into six supplier totals. Do not calculate any percentages or additional measures. Use tool output, not mental arithmetic. These are synthetic demonstration invoices.
